title: console: Setup → Datasources reports a failed Test in a green success toast, and turns a refused Sync into "No remote tables found on this datasource."
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): user-visible product defects with a public-door reproduction and named landings. Two positions of one family on one page: a refusal is drawn as success or as emptiness.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it to the lane that owns `packages/app-shell`. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 of objectstack-ai/objectstack (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-support-ai` · `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`, from the dev's out-of-scope findings 2 and 3 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24772 (report `6287715439`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What happens (the maintainer's HotCRM pass of 2026-10-20, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5)

1. **Test.** `POST /api/v1/datasources/default/test` answered 200 `{ ok: false, error: "[ObjectQL] Datasource 'default' has no registered driver to introspect." }`. The page showed that failure text in a **green success toast** (check icon). Evidence: [`38-integrations-datasources-test.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/38-integrations-datasources-test.png).
2. **Sync objects.** `GET /api/v1/datasources/default/remote-tables` answered 400. The page showed an error toast and then a dialog reading "No remote tables found on this datasource.", so a refusal reads as an empty datasource. Evidence: [`38-integrations-datasources-sync-objects.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/38-integrations-datasources-sync-objects.png).

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24772 makes those two server answers true (its seat ruling `6287770114`). A Test that fails or a Sync that is refused can still happen on any datasource, and the page still draws them as success and as emptiness.

## Where (read on objectui `main` `5129caa`, by code; no browser reading at that sha)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`:
- `test()` (around line 258) calls `toast.success(...)` for both `ok: true` and `ok: false`. The failure branch only changes the text.
- `openSync()` (around lines 446–451) catches the refusal, raises `toast.error(...)`, then `setTables([])`. The dialog's empty state then renders as if the datasource had no tables.

**Expected:** a failed Test reads as a failure. A refused Sync shows the refusal in the dialog (the ADR-0112 envelope's message), not the empty-datasource copy. ⛔ No server-meaning mapping in the console.

## Dedupe

objectui, MCP `search_issues`, open and closed, "datasource Test success toast shows failure, Sync dialog No remote tables found after refused introspection": 1 hit, objectui#11628 (closed). That one is the External Datasource panel reading the raw envelope, a different component and cause. **New.**

Dedupe words: datasource Test success toast on failure; toast.success ok false; Sync objects empty state on error; No remote tables found refusal.
